notes.title: 09/06/2022 Golf Gang Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Today we pushed another hotfix addressing some lingering issues and adding some quality-of-life improvements. Here they are!

[b]Hotfix #4 (09/06/2022)[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Alpine Resort (Complete a round on Alpine Resort) achievement not being awarded 
[*] Added some general stability improvements 
[*] Removed the Secret Key menu from the shop 
[*] Added a link to the first part of a workshop tutorial video within the workshop menu 
[*] Changed the lobby browser to now show games in progress 
[/list]

notes.title: 31/05/22 Golf Gang Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

Today we pushed a hotfix mostly focused on fixing some of the achievements in Golf Gang. Here’s what we specifically addressed: 

[b]Hotfix #3 (31/05/2022) [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Master: Sunny Suburbs achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Sunny Suburbs 
[*] Fixed Master: Winter Golf achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Winter Golf 
[*] Fixed Master: Sandy Shores achievement to unlock after obtaining overall S score on Sandy Shores 
[*] Fixed Master: Autumn Breeze achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Autumn Breeze 
[*] Fixed Master: Haunted Hallow achievement to unlock after obtaining overall S score on Haunted Hallow 
[*] Fixed Master: Alpine Resort achievement to unlock after obtaining overall S score on Alpine Resort 
[*] Fixed PERFECT RUN! Achievement to unlock after achieving S+ rank on every hole of any course in Golf Gang mode 
[*] Introduced the Steel Series headset as a customization item 
[*] Reverted cross-promotional store prices 
[/list]
